source:
@@U01320@@
(Aloud.)

@@U01321@@
Good-bye, ladies!

@@U01323@@
Good-bye!

@@U01325@@
Oh, but one thing more, sir! Tell me, won't you? Quickly? Is there a witness to when, where and how my poor darling died, and where he was buried? I’m an organized person, you see; I so like order. And I would like to read the account in the weekly journal.

@@U01327@@
Of course, good woman! The truth demands two witnesses. I have an excellent companion I'll take to the judge for you, then bring him here.

@@U01329@@
Oh, yes, please do!

@@U01331@@
And the young lady? Will she be here, too? He’s a fine young man! Well traveled, and shows every politeness to young ladies.

@@U01333@@
I'd blush just to meet him.

@@U01335@@
Blush? No king could make you blush, dear child.
translation:
@@U01320@@
（大声）

@@U01321@@
再见，女士们！

@@U01323@@
再见！

@@U01325@@
噢，还有一件事，先生！告诉我，好吗？迅速地？有目击者证明我可怜的宝贝何时、何地、如何死亡以及他被埋葬在哪里吗？你看，我是一个有组织的人；我太喜欢秩序了我想读一下周刊上的报道。

@@U01327@@
当然是好女人！真相需要两个证人。我有一个很好的同伴，我会帮你带去见法官，然后把他带到这里。

@@U01329@@
哦，是的，请这样做！

@@U01331@@
那年轻的女士呢？她也会在这里吗？他是一个优秀的年轻人！游历广泛，对年轻女士表现出十足的礼貌。

@@U01333@@
光是见到他我就会脸红。

@@U01335@@
脸红？亲爱的孩子，没有哪个国王能让你脸红。
